integrity: Analytical proof reconstructed from scalar-product positivity, singular product-area integration, and a total-variation mixture transfer. Reproducible stochastic checks do not prove the asymptotics. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: This is a sharp epsilon-to-zero asymptotic and conditional joint limit only. No finite-eccentricity closed form or numerical stability is established. A publicly available 2025 multi-integral formula for the finite-eccentricity probability is a significant antecedent; full historical priority has not been independently established.
title: A logarithmic acute-triangle law and conditional shape limit for thin ellipses
